description: Department of Cooperative Development - Central Provincial Council - Cancellation of Registration of Co-operative Societies, Nuwara Eliya
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the cancellation of registration for several co-operative societies (Doruwadeniya Thrift and credit cooperative society, Rojasangama Thrift and credit cooperative Society, Higurukaduwa Thrift and credit cooperative society). This falls under business/commercial matters, specifically the regulation and dissolution of commercial entities, which aligns with Type 6 (Commercial Gazettes) for business registrations and corporate dissolutions.
